title: Protocol semantic model, application design scaffold v0.1.0
description: Original scaffold informed by public AD protocols. Structural validity does not mean clinical completeness or M11/USDM conformance. Arrays may be absent for partial extraction. Completeness, reference integrity, temporal logic, formulas and clinical decisions require separate validation.

scope.description: An absent scope dimension is unspecified, not automatically global. Explicitly review inheritance.

expression.description: An expression tree, not executable free text. Operator arity, units, temporal interpretation, null behavior and variable bindings require semantic validation. Judgment nodes require a responsible person; do not invent a threshold.

time_reference.description: Resolve the anchor before converting nominal weeks or source Day 0/Day 1 labels.

action.description: An operational instruction must resolve target, owner, timing, and applicable conditions before it is complete.

data_handling.description: Post-event handling is separate from handling an actually unobserved measurement. Do not delete source measurements.

assertion.description: Pointer targets the canonical model or an unresolved absent field. Do not populate redacted values with invented content; competing source values can coexist as assertions.
